analyzed_vuln.description: `iloc_box_read` allocates `GF_ItemLocationEntry` with `gf_malloc` but never initializes it before adding it to `ptr->location_entries`. For malformed/truncated `iloc` input, parsing exits early (error propagated to `gf_isom_box_parse_ex`), and cleanup calls `iloc_box_del` -> `iloc_entry_del`, which unconditionally does `gf_list_count(location->extent_entries)`. Because `extent_entries` was never initialized, this is an invalid pointer dereference (crash observed in `gf_list_count`).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: PoV provides an `iloc` box with insufficient payload (`size=0` in sample), causing `iloc_box_read` to fail before setting up all fields of a newly allocated `location_entry`. The partially initialized entry remains in `location_entries` due to `gf_list_add` happening before full initialization. During error cleanup (`gf_isom_box_del` path), `iloc_entry_del` dereferences uninitialized `location->extent_entries`, triggering SEGV.
